code_effect_same_MODEL_and_USER_inputs.definition: V12 and V13 code replayed offline on the same global response and USER receipts; receipts were produced in V13 dialogues, so this isolates validation/selection/export, not how a V12 narrator would have conducted the dialogue.

USER_protocol_effect_same_V13_code.definition: [cohort_1, cohort_2] means per exported DOCX; same 120 hashes, B0, model, SOURCE, FORM, scenarios and budget; only USER wording/recognition of preregistered choices changed. Different MODEL responses and failures: not a paired comparison.

not_measured: V12 E2E dialogue on the same 90 schedules
